Title: Net Works Rabbit Hole
Desc: Down the rabbit hole, forever: an original ink drawing after Lewis Carroll's 1865 book. Cupboards, book-shelves, maps, pictures and a jar of marmalade drift up the wall of the well past a girl who never lands.
